facts.fact: The NESDB executive summary says the General Information Authority is the body authorized to implement the digital identity project, with NESDB supervising, to issue and verify a digital ID wallet for each citizen; it presents a proposed framework and roadmap, not a service in use.
facts.system: Libya digital identity project (digital identity wallet)

systems.system: Libya digital identity project (digital identity wallet)
systems.platform: mobile wallet app with central issuance and verification system

LBY.note: The document does not say civil register and ID system exchange records; the Civil Status Authority is only named as a project partner.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
Nothing on a number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register is said to be keyed on the national number.
The national number is described only as an identifier for digital services, found insufficient; nothing on issuance, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: The NESDB executive summary says some digital transactions between government departments, such as national number matching, are provided in completing some digital services for citizens.

LBY.note: No international standards body membership or adopted standard is stated.
Nothing on local civil registration offices.
